title: Devil Returns To School Days
altTitles: The Devil Returns to School Days
悪魔が学生時代に戻ってきた
Ác Ma Trở Lại Thời Đi Học
El Diablo Regresa a los Días Escolares
O Diabo Retorna aos Dias de Escola
ปีศาจกลับมาเรียน
description: Kim Hyunsung was an exemplary student with excellent grades, good looks, fighting ability, and a strong sense of justice. After being pushed from a school rooftop just before graduation, he spends ten years trapped in a vegetative state, fully conscious but unable to move or die. He suddenly returns to the day his bullying began, giving him a chance to confront those who ruined his life and become the 'malice' that wipes out evil.
author: San Cheon
